words.title: Power Apps code app
words.for_whom: For developers building a business app their organisation runs in Power Apps.
words.explain: Write the app in TypeScript and React, with Dataverse and connectors as its data. Run it live here, then push it to your environment. You get a code app's folder with power.config.json.
